name: Earthnet
author: zenwattage
description: A live, full-resolution 3D Earth in the Omarchy bar: glowing arcs trace every internet connection to and from your machine.

barWidget.description: Live 3D globe of your internet connections

schema.label: Spin speed
schema.description: Radians per second of automatic rotation. Negative spins the other way.

schema.label: Data source
schema.description: On shows bundled sample connections instead of live traffic.

schema.label: GeoLite2 MMDB (optional)
schema.description: Offline GeoIP database. Leave empty to use the free ip-api.com lookup.
